+"""Interactive controller for the BEHAVIOR limited-mode R1Pro episode.
+
+Run with ``python -u /app/output/gen.py``.  Send one JSON command per line:
+  {"op":"obs"}
+  {"op":"joint_position", "actions":[...], "dt":0.1, "interpolate":"hold"}
+  {"op":"ee_pose", "actions":[...]}
+  {"op":"wait", "seconds":2}
+The controller prints compact execution metadata and saves each response under
+/app/output/runs.  The service owns the episode; reconnecting does not reset it.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import pathlib
+import sys
+import time
+
+import numpy as np
+from PIL import Image
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+RUNS = OUT / "runs"
+CAMERAS = (
+    "robot_r1:zed_link:Camera:0",
+    "robot_r1:left_realsense_link:Camera:0",
+    "robot_r1:right_realsense_link:Camera:0",
+)
+
+
+def save_obs(obs, name="obs"):
+    d = OUT / "observations"
+    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    for cam, img in obs.last.items():
+        Image.fromarray(np.ascontiguousarray(img)).save(d / f"{name}_{cam.split(':')[1]}.jpg", quality=92)
+
+
+def main():
+    print("Connecting to the live episode service...", flush=True)
+    robot = Robot()
+    spec = robot.spec()
+    (OUT / "spec.json").write_text(json.dumps(spec, indent=2))
+    print(json.dumps({"connected": True, "service": robot.base, "spec": spec}, indent=2), flush=True)
+    obs = robot.get_obs()
+    save_obs(obs, "initial")
+    print(json.dumps({"obs": "initial", "proprio": obs.meta.get("proprio"), "time_left_s": obs.meta.get("time_left_s")}, default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
+    RUNS.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    idx = 0
+    for line in sys.stdin:
+        try:
+            cmd = json.loads(line)
+            op = cmd["op"]
+            if op == "obs":
+                obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 0)), video=cmd.get("video", "frames"))
+                save_obs(obs, f"obs_{idx:03d}")
+                meta = obs.meta
+            elif op in ("joint_position", "ee_pose"):
+                res = robot.submit(op, cmd["actions"], dt=float(cmd.get("dt", 1/30)),
+                                   interpolate=cmd.get("interpolate", "linear"), note=cmd.get("note", ""))
+                idx += 1
+                res.save(str(RUNS / f"{idx:03d}"))
+                save_obs(res, f"after_{idx:03d}")
+                meta = res.meta
+            elif op == "wait":
+                obs = robot.get_obs(seconds=float(cmd.get("seconds", 1)), video=cmd.get("video", "mp4"))
+                idx += 1
+                obs.save(str(RUNS / f"{idx:03d}"))
+                save_obs(obs, f"after_{idx:03d}")
+                meta = obs.meta
+            elif op == "status":
+                meta = robot.status()
+            elif op == "quit":
+                break
+            else:
+                raise ValueError(f"unsupported op {op!r}")
+            print(json.dumps({"op": op, "meta": meta,
+                              "proprio": getattr(locals().get("res", None), "proprio", None)},
+                             default=lambda x: np.asarray(x).tolist()), flush=True)
+            if meta.get("done"):
+                print("EPISODE_DONE", flush=True)
+                break
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print(json.dumps({"error": type(exc).__name__, "message": str(exc)}), flush=True)
+            if type(exc).__name__ == "EpisodeOver":
+                break
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
